description: This file declares the `SnapshotCommandHandler` class and related enums and structures used for suspending and resuming threads via socket communication in the Android Open Source Project's Cuttlefish virtualization environment.

classes.name: SnapshotCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles suspend and resume commands for threads via socket communication, managing associated sockets and threading.

methods.name: SnapshotCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a communication channel and socket set.

methods.name: SuspendResumeHandler
methods.description: Private method to handle suspend/resume protocol logic.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Private method to join the handler thread.
